title: Complete the human teammate invite route
text: The engine registers create/list/revoke/reissue and reports the serving-mode form before invite entry. Name-code results include private sharing and lost-code recovery guidance; atomic store and dispatcher tests prove code secrecy and replay refusal. These registrations alone do not expose the CLI invite-code redemption choice or replace existing Team navigation. Keep the human-route teaching gap open until the CLI, self-host Team and hosted consumer have exact-candidate and deployed route evidence. Source-level registration tests do not prove a person can complete those routes.
